## Sheet to CRM sync
Every 15 minutes: read the Leads sheet -> validate rows (email, phone to E.164, stage) -> upsert new or changed rows into HubSpot contacts by email, in batches of 100 -> write "synced" or the error back into the CRM status column.

Dry run: POST sheet values to `/webhook/sheet-crm-sync?dry_run=1`.
